soldier: The soldier has the head and pronotum reddish brown, the forehead and mandibles blackish brown, antennae, legs and abdomen reddish yellow; the head very sparsely haired, the anterior margin of the labrum and the periphery of the pronotum with sparse long setae. Head rectangular, gradually expanding from front to back, widest at the back of the head, the posterior margin rather flat; the sides of the forehead slightly raised, slightly depressed between the two elevations. The inner margin of the left mandible with three teeth, that of the right with two. The anterior margin of the labrum rounded and blunt. Antennae with ten segments, the third segment on the right almost as long as the second, on the left distinctly shorter. The anterior half of the postmentum broad, the waist narrowest near the posterior end, the widest part about twice the narrowest. Pronotum like a horizontally placed rectangle, arched in the middle, the sides arcuate, the anterior margin broad and shallowly concave, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave. The hind femur distinctly swollen, more than half as wide as long.
